hero.title: From Idea to App Store in 3 Months.
hero.subtitle: One developer, one breathing app. A real record of the journey — the wins, the bugs, and everything in between.

timeline.title: Where it began
timeline.description: Tired of over-complicated health apps, I wanted something simple — just breathing. Sketched the first wireframes on a Sunday afternoon.

timeline.title: The First Working Build
timeline.description: The core breathing engine, visual circle animation, and the first set of patterns — Box, 4-7-8, and Resonance.

timeline.title: v1.0.0 — Submitted for Review
timeline.description: Submitted to the App Store. Two months of work, one deep breath.

timeline.title: v1.0.0 — Official Launch
timeline.description: Toona is officially on the App Store. Exactly two months from idea to launch. Thank you for being here.

timeline.title: 🚀 Toona v1.0.1 update Live
timeline.description:
New:
Saved Custom Mode
,CO2 trend in History,Smoother CO2 test + Retest,Better energy efficency.

timeline.title: v1.0.2 — What's Next
timeline.description: Still planning. If you have ideas or feedback, I'd love to hear from you.
